annotations.title: Rank communities by price or rent

description: Communities ranked by 12-month median sale price or median annual rent - the direct answer to 'cheapest areas', 'most expensive communities', 'most affordable rents'. Only communities with 30+ transactions are ranked; without a propertyClass filter, only residential classes (apartments + villas) count, so whole-building leases and land deals don't skew the medians.
